lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with 4 to 5 nodes per column forming a semi-rectilinear grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, resulting in localized intensity maxima at the grid intersections across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the most prominent ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to low-luminance shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8 to 10 high-luminance blobs are bounded within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered in the basal and posterior regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular indentations are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; no other major integumentary trauma or permanent scars are detectable.
other_distinctive_markers: Two Echeneidae (remoras) are visible: one positioned ventrally to the mid-flank and one trailing the pectoral fin. The pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller-diameter, high-luminance blobs toward its distal margin.
